page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2s.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, and is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB per core. The instance includes a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU allocation of approximately 0.0833, providing 2 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average single-core performance, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1884.98 and a Geekbench single-core score of 1595.0. However, multi-core performance is weak, as shown by a stress-ng multi-core score of 5733.3 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 4061.0. Memory performance is mixed; while cached small-block read bandwidth is high at 421.08 GB/sec, the Passmark memory score is poor at 1096.88. For specialized tasks, the fractional GPU delivers average performance on small LLM inference with 117.31 tokens/sec for text generation using a 135M model, but struggles on larger models, yielding a poor 4.57 tokens/sec on a 7B model.

This instance offers a cost-effective entry point for workloads requiring GPU acceleration without the expense of a full dedicated GPU. The fractional A10 GPU and 2 GB VRAM make it suitable for lightweight virtual workstations, basic image processing, and small-scale machine learning inference. It is also capable of handling static web serving, achieving 10.01 GB/sec in throughput, and Redis operations at 8.53 million operations per second. It is not recommended for memory-heavy databases, large-scale LLM inference, or highly multi-threaded compilation tasks.
